introduction: 211 Maryland helps residents find local health and human services, including food, housing and utility resources. Specialists use your location and circumstances to narrow the search.

who: The free, confidential service is available to everyone in Maryland.
Eligibility and funds are assessed separately by each referred provider.
sections.get: Telephone specialists are available 24 hours a day, every day. The online database offers another way to locate services. A referral does not reserve money or approve a benefit.
sections.docs: Have your ZIP code, immediate need and any deadline ready. Note providers you have tried and why they could not help. These are preparation suggestions, not an application checklist.
sections.apply:
1. Call 211.
  2. Alternatively search the resource database linked at 211 Maryland.
  3. Contact the referred organization to confirm service area, intake and current availability.
sections.after: Record referrals and responses. Ask for another option if the first provider cannot serve you. Confirm whether a listed text service provides resource conversation or an ongoing information subscription before relying on it for urgent help.
